(if (= (orientation) 1) (begin (dialog '(("The fun, the frustration, the dedication, the time spent.
What it is and what could have been.
I'm in it.
I'm in everything.
In every person, in every monster, in every dialog, in every rock.
I'm it.
I'm the enigma.
The room you couldn't get out, the useless items, the inside jokes you will ever understand.
I'm.
I'm all that is not there.
The houses with closed doors, the unreachable areas, the untold stories of every secondary character.
Their dreams and aspirations.
I'm the game. The whole and all its parts.
And you played me for {{minutes-played}} minutes.
As your journey continues, remember that you are not just playing a game; you are living me.")))) (dialog '(("Computers are not used from this side.")))))
